# Solo .Bizz

> Solo .Bizz is a calm, all-in-one CRM and finance tracker for psychologists, therapists, coaches and tutors running solo practices. Manage clients, sessions, payments and income in one place.

Solo .Bizz helps solo practitioners replace spreadsheets and scattered tools with a single workspace for client records, session scheduling, payment tracking and income/expense reporting. Paid plans: Solo (€12/month) and Pro (€24/month), billed monthly, quarterly (10% off) or yearly (20% off); new accounts get a 14-day free trial with Pro features. Payments are processed by Paddle. Specialists can also publish a public profile page with online booking.
